added.summary: New props line (a line under the name as the game words it, such as One-handed · Item level 60) and reason (why the main button is refused, as the game words it: Requires level 40, shown in red over the buttons while canPrimary is false). New parts RpgItemCard.hero, .band, .kicker, .line, .delta, .current, .stats, .lore, .actions and .reason.

--icard-* roles for the item card: the hero's height and art size (they follow the screen and give way to larger text), the rule under the hero, the name's glow, the headline figure's size, a change's up and down ink and fill and its arrow, the figure columns' widths, and the lore's rule and style. The card otherwise wears the inventory's --inv-* roles.

breaking.change: The card is redrawn: its frame is cut at two corners with a lit top edge; the art sits over a glow of its rarity; kind is a kicker in the rarity's colour over the name; the headline figure is large with its change as a chip (an arrow in the trend's colour) and what is equipped beside it, headed Equipped (it read Your current); the other figures are rows of this, change and equipped under This / Equipped headings, and drop under the label when the line is short; the lore hangs from a rule of the rarity; the art and the name scroll with the figures while the buttons sit side by side at the foot, the main one carrying the details action's key cap. On a phone or a short screen the art sits in a socket beside the name and the rows drop the equipped column. RpgItemCard.title and RpgItemCard.well are gone: the name is RpgItemCard.name only and the lore is RpgItemCard.lore.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed RpgItemCard.title dresses RpgItemCard.name; one that dressed the lore through RpgItemCard.well dresses RpgItemCard.lore. Pass line and reason to show them.
